DLSU · AdRIC · CIVI

Solving Real-World Problems using Computer Vision

The Center for Computational Imaging and Visual Innovations (CIVI) specializes in research projects centered towards solving real-world problems through deep learning solutions trained on visual data. Research projects under CIVI focus on specific goals, particularly (1) data collection, (2) model building and optimization, and (3) application development.

Paper Presentation in ICGSP 2026 🇯🇵

Awards

2026 February 18

Outstanding Thesis Award - Silver Medal for Hinolan, Javellana, Lapuz, and Tabadero

Congratulations to Charles Joseph Hinolan, Mac Andre Javellana, Mari Salvador Lapuz, and Audrea Arjaemi Tabadero on receiving the Outstanding Thesis Award (Silver Medal) for their work, "A Lightweight Computer Vision Model for Camouflaged Crop Detection." This marks CIVI`s second Outstanding Thesis Award in the BSCS program and third award overall. Their research evaluates lightweight object detection strategies, including pruning and knowledge distillation, to balance accuracy and computational efficiency for real-world agricultural applications.

Student Activity

2026 January 27 & 2026 February 17

Focused Research and Manuscript Enhancement (FRAME) Sprint in DLSU Laguna

CIVI held FRAME Sprint – Day 1 at the John Gokongwei Innovation Center, DLSU Laguna Campus, on January 27 and February 16, 2026, guiding BSMSCS and THS-ST3 students in refining research manuscripts and preparing papers for conference and journal submission.

Faculty Engagement

2025 December 11

CIVI joins GAME Lab in DOST-PCIEERD Grand MOA Signing 2025

CIVI participated in the DOST-PCIEERD Grand MOA Signing for 2025 Approved Projects on December 11, 2025, at the Philippine Trade Training Center. The event recognized a DOST-PCIEERD-funded project with DLSU GAME Lab exploring synthetic 3D scenes for computer vision.
